name: Moseley Electronics
old_description: Brian Moseley, Director of Technology spent some time with CBS6 talking about the advantages of outdoor lighting.
about:
Moseley Electronics operates from Midlothian, Virginia, serving the greater Richmond area. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed; Brian Moseley holds the title of Director of Technology, and a team member named Mike is referenced in customer feedback.

The company provides lighting, audio-visual, and integrated wiring solutions for both commercial and residential projects. Its services span outdoor lighting integration, shade installation, home theater systems, and commercial AV installations such as the audio and wiring renovation at the historic Hotel Petersburg boutique hotel. A dedicated division, ambiance by MOSELEY, focuses on lighting, shades, and integration with a team of designers and service technicians.

Clients include houses of worship, hospitality properties, and residential homeowners. The Hotel Petersburg project exemplifies commercial work, while long-term residential customers in the Richmond area reference home theater and ongoing service relationships spanning more than a decade.

The company emphasizes the experience level of its design and service technicians in lighting, shades, and integration, and highlights attention to detail throughout the order and installation process as a distinguishing factor.
